title: The Flat Viewing
summary: Alex remembers your help with the boxes and tells you that the bigger flat upstairs is free. Ask the right questions before you decide.
npc_opening: Thanks again for helping me the other day! Guess what, the flat upstairs is empty now. I have the key. Do you want to see it? Ask me anything.

objectives.description: Ask how much the rent is.
Ask about the rooms, the bills or the neighbours.
Explain what you need in a new home.
